## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text is the Míng-period merging-and-abridgement of [圓覺](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E8%A6%BA) Yuánjué's earlier 3-fascicle *[Yuán rén lùn jiě](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0107)* (X1032), edited by [揚嘉祚](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%8F%9A%E5%98%89%E7%A5%9A) Yáng Jiāzuò. The result is a more compact and accessible version of Yuánjué's Yuán-period commentary, suitable for late-Míng monastic and lay study.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1370 – 1644) reflects the broad late-Yuán to late-Míng period during which the editorial merging took place. The work documents the late-imperial Chinese Buddhist tradition's continuing engagement with [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's foundational *Yuán rén lùn*, which by then had been the subject of more than seven centuries of continuous commentarial activity.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1033) collection.
